title: SetupGuard configuration
description: Optional configuration for a repository diagnosed by SetupGuard. Its purpose is to let a project declare legitimate exceptions, not to define policy.

version.description: Configuration format version. Only 1 is supported.

checks.description: Severity overrides, keyed by check id. Which ids exist depends on the adapters loaded, so the schema accepts any key and the loader rejects unknown ones.

severity.description: error and warning re-level every finding the check produces; off stops the check from running.

optional.description: Variables the project works without. Names only; SetupGuard never reads a value.

ignore.description: Workspace-relative glob patterns excluded from the source and documentation scans. Structural files such as the root package.json are never hidden.
